title: YXMEEGLE SOP default task implementation catalog
notes: Raw fields preserve the supplied source, including proposed automation, source-write references, TODOs and contradictory statements. They are not executable instructions or approvals.
The nine-node display mapping and shared-task behavior are PRD design proposals; original group values remain unchanged.
Business applicability and participant bindings remain case-specific. Forty-four is a ceiling of standard task definitions before applicability and selections, not tasks due immediately.
No PDF handwriting is converted automatically into user identities, permissions or seed assignments.
Branch mappings are proposed implementation mappings; verify canonical local node IDs per case. Workbook Meegle IDs are not runtime state IDs.
